senses.gloss:
ऐंदव a. (वी f.) [इंदु-अण्] Lunar;
Māl. 8. 1; U. 1. 34.
--वः A lunar
month.
--वी The plant सोमराजी.
--वं
1 The asterism Mṛgaśiras.
--2
The Vrata called चांद्रायण q. v.;
Ms. 11. 126.

ऐंद्र a. (द्री f.) [इंद्र-अण्]
Belonging or sacred to Indra; R. 2. 50;
6. 27.
--द्रः
1 N. of Arjuna and of
Vāli (who are regarded as sons of
इंद्र).
--2 N. of a Saṃvatsara.
--3
The part of a sacrifice offered to
Indra.
--द्री
1 N. of a Ṛk
addressed to Indra; इत्यादिका काचिदैंद्री
समाम्नाता J. N. V.
--2 The east, eastern
direction (presided over by Indra);
अयमैंद्रीमुखं पश्य रक्तश्चुंबति चंद्रमाः
Chandr. 5. 58; Ki. 9. 18.
--3 The
eighteenth lunar mansion.
--4 The
eighth day in the second half
of the months of मार्गशीर्ष and
पौष.
--5 Indra's energy
(personified as his wife Śacī).
--6
Misfortune, misery.
--7 A kind of
cucumber.
--8 An epithet of Durgā.
--9 Small cardamom.
--द्रं
1 The
eighteenth lunar mansion (ज्येष्ठा).
--2
Wild ginger.

ऐंद्रजालिक a. (की f.) [इंद्रजालेन चरति
ठक्]
1 Deceptive, magical, illusive.
--2 Familiar with magic.
--कः A
juggler; Śi. 15. 25.

ऐंद्रतुरीयः The fourth part of a
libation to Indra.

ऐंद्रलुप्तिक a. (की f.) Affected
with morbid baldness of the head.

ऐंद्राग्न a. Relating to Indra and
Agni; so ऐंद्रवारुण, ऐंद्रसौम्य &c.

ऐंद्रिः [इंद्रस्यापत्यं-इञ्]
1 N. of
Jayanta, Arjuna, or Vāli, the
monkey-chief.
--2 A crow; ऐंद्रिः
किल नखैस्तस्या विददार स्तनौ द्विजः
R. 12. 22.

ऐंद्रिय, --यक a. [इंद्रिय-अण्, वुञ् वा]
1 Belonging to the senses, sensual.
[]
--2 Present, perceptible to the
senses.
--यं The world of the senses.

ऐंद्रिय, --यक a. [इंद्रिय-अण्, वुञ् वा]
1 Belonging to the senses, sensual.
[]
--2 Present, perceptible to the
senses.
--यं The world of the senses.

ऐंद्रियेधी a. Thinking only of
sensual pleasures.
